daily.today_energy: Mercury's got your back today, Aries. You're radiating that main character energy—use it to start conversations you've been putting off. Trust the vibe shift happening right now.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your confidence, and honestly, they should be. Whether you're single or coupled up, lean into your authenticity. Real connection happens when you stop performing.
daily.career: Your ideas hit different today. Don't second-guess yourself in meetings or group chats—speak up. The universe is backing your vision, so let it flow naturally without overthinking.
daily.health: Your body's telling you it needs movement. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever makes you feel alive. Energy moves better when you move it. Rest isn't laziness, it's strategy.

weekly.overview: Mercury's moving through your sector this week, bringing clarity to situations that felt foggy. Trust your gut—it's basically your spiritual GPS right now. This is peak energy for setting intentions that actually stick around.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, Venus is whispering that vulnerability hits different. If you've been holding back, now's the time to say the thing. Real connections happen when we stop performing, so just be your messy, authentic self.
weekly.career: Your vibe is noticeably stronger around collaborative projects. Leadership comes naturally this week, but remember it's not about being the loudest voice—it's about bringing out the best in others. Your instincts on what needs to happen are spot-on.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional movement, not punishment. Whether that's a walk, dancing in your room, or yoga, listen to what feels nourishing rather than restrictive. Energy flows better when you're actually enjoying what you're doing.
